content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab LTD (UK) to GitLab BV (Belgium), how does the duration of full salary continuation for sick leave change?","answer":"In the UK, you receive Statutory Sick Pay for up to 28 weeks, whereas in Belgium you receive 30 days of full salary continuation.","evidence_a":"Statutory Sick Pay for up to 28 weeks","evidence_b":"30 days full salary continuation (regardless of seniority)"}
